title: LocationStudio Environment Definition Language v1
description: Declarative description of a whole location. Compiled by LocationStudio (edl_compile / edl_apply / edl_build) into one authoring-plan transaction and then into game archives. The compiler performs further checks (unique ids, fits, references).
